posts.name: Moli by Lexmount
posts.tagline: The fastest headless browser for agents and harnesses
posts.description: Moli by Lexmount is our browser engine built from scratch for AI agents. It starts faster and uses less memory than Chrome. Use Moli through Lexmount Browser, our cloud browser platform. Run multiple isolated browser sessions with proxy support while we handle the infrastructure. Let your agents browse, fill out forms, and extract data. Try it in our Playground or connect through our SDK.

posts.name: Badgey
posts.tagline: Your iPhone becomes a name badge that faces the room
posts.description: Badgey turns your iPhone into a name badge. On a lanyard, it turns to face the people you meet and swings as you move. In a chest pocket, it shrinks so your name shows above the edge. Several badges, a QR code for your link, five designs.

posts.name: AgentGrid.io
posts.tagline: Shared workspace for humans and agents
posts.description: Built for Grok Bot, Muse AI, Instinct, Hermes, Claude, GPT, OpenClaw, Cursor, Codex, all agents are welcome. Work on the same live artifacts. Docs, reports, slides, apps, and designs, with shared context, controlled access, and full version history.

posts.name: git-flow-next
posts.tagline: Your favorite Git workflow. Reimagined.
posts.description: A flexible, modern approach to the popular git-flow branching model. Download the CLI tool to get started with a better Git workflow: brew install git-flow-next

posts.name: Llama Windows
posts.tagline: One local AI server for all your Windows apps
posts.description: Llama Windows brings llama.cpp to the Windows 11 system tray. Download open models from Hugging Face in one click, chat via Alt+Space, and let coding agents, editors and scripts share a local OpenAI-compatible API and model cache. Free and open source.

posts.name: Openstatus Incident Management
posts.tagline: Incident management for small teams
posts.description: Open source incident management next to your monitors and status page. Declare from Slack, get a channel per incident, keep a timeline and draft the postmortem.

posts.name: pawl
posts.tagline: a tiny mac focus timer you start by pulling a paw
posts.description: start a focus timer by pulling a cat paw, it lives in your mac menu bar or you can pin it like a mini timer! it has adjustable focus and break sessions, eight cat paws, themes, and a quiet heads-up before your timer ends. made for macos 14+. $9.99 once, with no subscription.

posts.name: MRRaudit
posts.tagline: Understand why your MRR differs and get a number you trust
posts.description: MRRaudit explains why your MRR numbers differ so you can get to a figure you trust. Compare Stripe and ChartMogul customer by customer, trace discrepancies to invoices and subscription events, and choose how billing events affect MRR. Built by the ChartMogul team, who've obsessed over SaaS metrics since 2014 and helped thousands of SaaS businesses investigate these differences by hand through calls and support tickets. Read-only access. No ChartMogul account required.

posts.name: Papermark Data Rooms
posts.tagline: Secure data rooms your AI agents can run. Live in < 60 sec.
posts.description: Data Rooms 2.0: launch a secure data room in under 60 seconds. Encrypted, fully certified, with file permissions, built-in Q&A, a full audit log and analytics. White-label it on your domain, or let agents run it via API, CLI and MCP.

posts.name: Clips by Plastic
posts.tagline: Lyric video ads for every part of your song, on the beat
posts.description: Drop in a finished song and your own footage or photos. Clips finds the tempo and every part (verses, pre-chorus, chorus, bridge) and makes a vertical lyric video for each one, cut on the beat, with the words synced. Pick a layout and one of 54 effects, then export every part on every backdrop at once, named and ready for Ads Manager. Run them all for a week and put your budget behind the part that wins. Works offline. Free to try, then $99 once.

posts.name: How It Spread
posts.tagline: See how anything went viral, from the first post
posts.description: A library of 1,000+ viral films, products, memes and campaigns. Each case embeds the original, dates every step from first post to peak, sources every number and scores the spread from data. New breakouts get traced as they spread. Free to browse.

posts.name: Yourcast 2.0
posts.tagline: AI summaries with tap-to-jump timestamps, right in Telegram
posts.description: Yourcast is a Telegram bot for podcasts: search a show, tap to subscribe, and new episodes arrive as audio right in your chat. 2.0 adds AI summaries with timestamps you can tap to jump in the audio, questions about any episode, feeds that repair themselves, files up to 2 GB, OPML import and payments in Telegram Stars. Free: 10 episodes a week on demand. Open source (GPL v3). In English, Russian, Portuguese, Spanish, German and Hebrew.

posts.name: Specsight
posts.tagline: Product observability for teams shipping fast with AI
posts.description: Shipping fast with AI? Specsight turns code changes into a living product map, feature knowledge, and clear release updates. Keep Product, Sales, and Support in sync with what your software actually does and what changed.

posts.name: Sunlight Diary
posts.tagline: AI cheerleader based on daily sunlight target
posts.description: Meet Sunlight Diary, a personal cheerleader based on daily sunlight target. Our AI agent helps you choose a daily sunlight goal, get a suggested outdoor routine, record your time outside, and check in with how you feel. Louie is your companion along the way. Try it in your phone's browser — no wearable needed.

posts.name: Save My Prompts
posts.tagline: Save the prompts that work. Reuse them everywhere.
posts.description: Save My Prompts helps you save, organize, improve, and reuse your best AI prompts across your workflow. Create reusable templates with customizable variables, find prompts instantly, organize projects with boards, and access your library through browser extensions and supported AI integrations. Stop rewriting prompts from scratch and spend more time getting useful results from AI.

posts.name: LinkedEmbed
posts.tagline: LinkedIn Widgets for Websites
posts.description: LinkedEmbed is a no-code LinkedIn widget builder that lets you embed LinkedIn feeds, posts, profiles, recommendations, company job listings, projects, and certifications on any website. Create beautiful, customizable LinkedIn widgets for WordPress, Webflow, Wix, Shopify, Squarespace, and more. Showcase professional social proof, display LinkedIn content, and track widget views, clicks, and engagement. All from one simple dashboard. No coding required.

posts.name: Stirred Art
posts.tagline: Strava for bars, Vivino for cocktails
posts.description: Stirred Art scans your photos, detects bars and drinks, builds your flavour profile based on eleven flavours like bitter, smoky and umami, and then personalises bar menus. Everything works offline, so you can get a ranked menu even in the most speakeasy basement out there. It also shows what you can make at home, remembers what each friend drinks (and what they can't), and turns your photos into a map of the bars and drinks you loved.

posts.name: InfiForm
posts.tagline: The conversational form builder without response penalties
posts.description: InfiForm is an AI-powered conversational form builder engineered for modern teams. Create high-converting surveys, quizzes, and lead magnets in seconds with natural language prompts, 20+ question archetypes, partial response capture, and zero response penalties.

posts.name: Reels Flow
posts.tagline: Turn ideas and images into AI-powered videos
posts.description: ReelsFlow helps creators, marketers, and businesses turn text prompts and images into AI-generated videos and visuals for YouTube Shorts, Instagram Reels, TikTok, and more. Explore multiple AI models to bring creative ideas to life.

posts.name: TONAUT
posts.tagline: Synth, drums, sequencer and 8-track tape for iPhone and iPad
posts.description: Tonaut is a synth, drum machine, sequencer and eight-track tape for iPhone and iPad, made to be played rather than programmed. 9 synth engines, over 500 sounds, 41 drum kits, a chord pad, 16 effects and an eight-lane sequencer. On iPhone, five housings with key LEDs. $19.99 - one-time purchase for iPhone and iPad. No subscription, no account. AUv3 is coming in 2.0, free.

posts.name: TONAUT
posts.tagline: Synth, drums, sequencer and 8-track tape for iPhone and iPad

Play solo as Edgar or team up with a friend in local split-screen co-op as Mabel. The Kickstarter supports more game artwork, a new website, and marketing, with a larger map and more features planned.

posts.name: Benchpress
posts.tagline: Every OCR model is #1 somewhere. Test them on your own pages
posts.description: Every OCR model is topping some benchmarks. But can they lift your documents? 💪 Drop in one page, and every major OCR and document AI reads it. See who got it right, where each one slipped, and who was fastest and cheapest.

posts.name: Drint
posts.tagline: Packaging design software: dielines, 3D mockups, print files
posts.description: Drint is packaging design software in the browser. Pick a structure or a FEFCO / ECMA code, type the size, and design straight on a real dieline while the 3D mockup folds as you draw. Export print-ready CMYK PDF/X-4 with cut and crease lines, plus finishing files for foil, spot UV and embossing. About a thousand ready mockups for boxes, bags, cartons, cans and labels, in 14+ languages. Free to start.

posts.name: Tabula
posts.tagline: A free native Mac database client with optional offline AI
posts.description: Contribute to tungnguyenvan/tabula development by creating an account on GitHub.

posts.description: A free learning site for people with a high need for cognition. 12 tracks, from Venture Capital and Investment Banking to Consulting, Strategy and AI: 283 curated reads, 229 module kits, 8 practice cases. Email-code sign-in; progress syncs across devices.

posts.name: CodeZen
posts.tagline: From vibe to live: software that keeps evolving
posts.description: Describe your app in plain language, even on WhatsApp. CodeZen's AI agents plan, build and deploy it, then keep shipping changes toward the KPI you set. Living code: you own it, no lock-in, EU servers. Free plan, no card.

posts.name: 2G
posts.tagline: neural synthesis, but it’s 2002
posts.description: 2G is a sampler that looks and sounds like an early-2000s handheld devices. We imagined what Neural Synthesis would have been like back then. Describe a sound and 2G makes it. Then edit it and play it from your computer keyboard, or load your own audio instead. 2G is free for Windows and macOS, as a plugin or a standalone app, and starts you with 20 credits for generating sounds. Studio ($10/month, 7-day trial) gives you 200 credits a month.

posts.name: Screenodon
posts.tagline: Nail Your App Store Screenshots
posts.description: Make your whole App Store and Google Play screenshot set in one sitting: an AI draft from raw screenshots, real device frames, 39 languages and publishing straight to App Store Connect. New: all four iPhone Duo sizes. Try it without an account.

posts.name: Wayside
posts.tagline: A Grimdark Fantasy Journal
posts.description: Wayside is a grimdark fantasy journaling app. It is inspired by old DOS terminals and retrogames and takes you on a fantasy journey as you journal. Every day you return to the app, you will be greeted by a new scene and description. As you continue your journey, you'll discover new biomes and meet new companions. If you find wellness apps hard to relate to, this offers a journaling experience that doesn't push mindfulness but just offers solace, adventure and exploration along a difficult road.

posts.name: Math Verse

posts.description: Math Verse — interactive Class 11 mathematics learning platform.

Whether you're looking to improve your workouts, monitor your nutrition, or stay active, Zafit can be a valuable tool in your fitness journey.

Bilingual (EN/中文), light/dark themes, privacy-first (anonymous owner key lives in your browser's localStorage).

posts.tagline: Now on Mac, with a voice coach in your AirPods

AirPosture turns the motion sensors in your AirPods into a posture coach. When your head drifts forward, a calm voice helps you sit back up. Plus 30-second resets and a weekly view of your posture, with iPhone and Mac in sync. Free for 2 hours a day.

Private by design. On iPhone, iPad, Android and the web.

Press Option + D over any app, say what you want, and keep working. Shrink for social media, cut filler words, find the best moments, reframe to vertical, and automate it across hundreds of files. Your video never leaves your device. Bring your own AI key: $5 can last months, not $20 every month.

posts.name: X (Twitter) Character Counter
posts.tagline: Counts like X: emojis as 2, every link as 23
posts.description: Paste a post and see exactly what X will count: emojis and Asian characters count as 2, every link as 23, against the 280 limit. Live preview, all 10 networks' limits side by side. Free, no signup, 41 languages.

posts.name: LocalsVoted
posts.tagline: Your city’s best, voted by locals
posts.description: LocalsVoted is a website where locals vote for the best in their city, on any topic. Rank comes only from votes.

posts.name: LazyWords
posts.tagline: Your own dictionaries, now floating flashcards on Windows
posts.description: Turn your own CSV, JSON or XLSX dictionaries into floating flashcards on Windows. Review vocabulary, technical terms or course notes while you work. Set the timing, mark familiar cards as learned, and keep decks and progress locally.

posts.name: P Viewer
posts.tagline: Open CT and MRI discs in your browser, no install
posts.description: A free DICOM viewer for physicians, researchers and students. Drop a CT or MRI disc, zip or folder into the browser: images are processed on your own computer. MPR, MIP, window presets, measurements, anonymised share links that expire in two hours, and research segmentation tools. Also on iPhone, iPad and Android.

posts.name: IntelliLinks
posts.tagline: Link Intelligence Platform
posts.description: Turn every link into a measurable marketing channel. Create, brand, track, retarget, and optimize your links with IntelliLinks.

posts.name: NapDog
posts.tagline: Your cozy pixel-art companion for work and study
posts.description: Meet NapDog, a cozy pixel-art Shiba Inu who keeps you company while you work or study. Watch your little friend nap, wander around, drink water, and happily welcome you back when you return. Enjoy a simple focus timer, playful conversations, and a peaceful little companion. Completely free. No sign-up required.

posts.name: Buoy
posts.tagline: A desktop home for tmux, files, and remote localhost
posts.description: Buoy is a free, open-source desktop tmux client for macOS, Windows, and Linux. Reconnect to running sessions, preview files and self-contained HTML in place, recognize localhost links, open remote services through automatic SSH tunnels, and drag files or folders into the terminal to upload them to its current directory.

posts.name: Indian Movie Hour
posts.tagline: Hindi & Marathi Blockbusters, Classics & More
posts.description: Watch full Hindi and Marathi movies free and legally, streamed from the official YouTube channels of the studios that own them. Browse by actor, genre and decade.

posts.name: FirmQuote
posts.tagline: Fixed-price quotes clients approve. Free for initial users.
posts.description: Send a fixed-price quote on one link and get your client’s yes on that exact version. No client account needed. Extra requests become priced change orders, with the advance paid before work starts. Paid straight through your payment link, with tax fields and PDF quotes.

posts.name: Dhumketu
posts.tagline: AI-Powered Infinite Learning Platform
posts.description: Learn anything with AI. Explore infinite topic trees, courses, research papers, and books — all powered by artificial intelligence.

posts.name: 37Studio
posts.tagline: AI makes videos, posts them, answers DMs and comments
posts.description: Brief a video in plain words: Claude Code makes it in your brand, posts it to 9 platforms and answers DMs and comments from your own knowledge base. Built for agencies with many brands. Runs on your computer with your keys. Free, open source, no subscription.

posts.name: eat-sheep-sleep-repeat
posts.tagline: failing to fall asleep? try eat-sheep-sleep-repeat.
posts.description: simple tools to help you slow down and fall asleep.

posts.name: VidKart YouTube Video Cutter
posts.tagline: Free online YouTube video cutter
posts.description: Free online YouTube video cutter. Paste a link, cut and trim any part of a YouTube video to the second, then share it or download as MP4.

posts.name: Commit Garden
posts.tagline: Keep a plant alive by coding every day
posts.description: Commit Garden is a gamified streak for your GitHub. Push at least one commit a day and your plant is watered. 6 days in a row and it’s fully grown and joins your garden. Skip a day and it withers. Side quests earn gems. We never store your code.

posts.name: Waver AI
posts.tagline: Voice-first notes with an AI that remembers
posts.description: Waver AI is a voice-first notes app that does far more than take notes. Record, dictate, scan handwriting, talk to an AI that remembers what you said, and turn ideas into images, video and music in one place. Made by Aerosoul Technologies, a new company in Chennai building apps for everyday life.

posts.name: Zen Flow Yoga
posts.tagline: A refined React template for yoga & wellness websites
posts.description: A responsive React + TypeScript website template for yoga studios and wellness brands. Features an editorial homepage, searchable pose library, journal, and interactive breathing tool. Customize branding and content through centralized configuration, then deploy as a static website.

posts.name: Your Stressy
posts.tagline: One number for your energy, on iPhone and Apple Watch
posts.description: Stressy turns your Apple Watch data into one number, your reserve (0–100%). Sleep fills it, stress drains it. Readiness, a bedtime coach and widgets for iPhone and Watch. Calculated on device, nothing leaves it. $4.99 once, never a subscription.

posts.name: PitchFlow
posts.tagline: AI Proposal Writer for Freelancers
posts.description: Generate winning freelance proposals in 10 seconds. Built for Upwork, Fiverr, and Freelancer.

posts.name: FrameAdapt
posts.tagline: Smooth, stable frametimes ideal, FPS cap for your games.
posts.description: Smooth, stable frametimes in one click. the ideal FPS cap for your monitor and games.
